cohort: Consecutive paediatric patients aged 2-18, diagnosed with obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) and booked for tonsillectomy +/- adenoidectomy, were recruited from Swan Hill, Victoria.
finding: Remotely-delivered oximetry (RDO) was as diagnostically accurate as hospital-delivered oximetry (HDO), with significantly faster delivery times (23.6 days vs 87.7 days) and strong patient preference (25/28 preferred RDO).
